in_marathi.name: Mythil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Star of the Night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mythil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mythil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mythra' meaning 'star'. The name is associated with the night sky and is believed to bring good fortune and protection.
